relations.subject: Chögyam Trungpa
relations.evidence: His father left India in early 1963 to study at Oxford University.

relations.subject: Sakyong Jamgon Mipham Rinpoche
relations.evidence: After his father's death in 1987, the Sawang began his studies with Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche in Nepal, which continued until the Mahasiddah's death.

relations.subject: Sakyong Jamgon Mipham Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Mukpo began his studies with Pema Norbu Rinpoche (Penor Rinpoche) in India, where he attended Shedra at Namdrolling Monastery

relations.subject: Sakyong Jamgon Mipham Rinpoche
relations.evidence: where he attended Shedra at Namdrolling Monastery and continued to oversee the Vajradhatu community.

relations.subject: Sakyong Jamgon Mipham Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In late 2008 and early 2009 the Sakyong received the Rinchen Terdzo, the complete cycle of terma teachings of the Nyingma school of Buddhism, from Namkha Drimed Rinpoche in Orissa, India.
